values.note: Macon County: RV site without sewer $30/night, full hookup $35; primitive tent site $18 per tent; weekly $150 (14 nights max). The camping rate table lists a 'Park Pass (per vehicle)' at $5 and the page an 'Entrance Fee Per Car $5.00' (annual pass $50); it does not say whether campers pay it once or daily. No resident/non-resident split.

note: Macon County park (482 acres) at 165 Whitewater Rd, Oglethorpe, on Whitewater Creek's millpond: bathhouse, boat launch, fishing docks, beach. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Macon County's park and rate pages: $30 (no sewer) / $35 full hookup, 29 RV sites all 50/30/20A with water, sewer at 17, dump, phone reservations. Added a $5 per-vehicle Park Pass (fees.entrance; page doesn't say daily or once), 14-night cap and site breakdown (17/12, not the note's 16/13). Season left as is: the page says the PARK is open year-round, not specifically the campground. Note cleaned.
flags: Fees: the camping rate table carries 'Park Pass (per vehicle) $5.00' and the page an 'Entrance Fee Per Car $5.00'; recorded as a $5 per-vehicle charge per stay because the county doesn't say whether campers pay it daily - if it is daily, per should be vehicle_day.

Waterfront re-audit lead (stored 'not waterfront'): on Esri imagery the southern RV loop (around 32.3507,-84.0719) sits on open grass roughly 25-40 m above the creek's main channel where it enters the millpond, with no tree screen between some pads and the water; the county page doesn't describe the sites' water frontage. Worth a look at the per-site view.
Pin: 32.35105,-84.07007 is near the park office/entrance area, roughly 220-250 m east of the centre of the RV loops (~32.3509,-84.0724). Borderline; move only if you want the dot on the sites.
